scripts.text:
[Warpra]
Hello,
I can warp you to any town or dungeon, but you need to unlock them first by visiting us.
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[沃普拉]
您好！我可以將您傳送到各個城鎮或地下城，不過得先去當地找我們解鎖。
您需要什麼服務？
怎麼能傳送的地點這麼少？
